latest_production_code_candidate.description: Latest isolated production-code candidate. Relevant module_ra_rrtmgp.F bytes at the PR112 evidence-only head are identical. Not merged main.

ccpp_reference.classification: Pinned public HAFS/UFS CCPP source chain. It is not an authenticated release tag or proof of a particular deployed binary.

comparisons.candidate: In the unmerged candidate, the six SW gases are H2O, CO2, O3, N2O, CH4, O2 (module_ra_rrtmgp.F:69,453-470). LW has those six plus CFC11, CFC12, CFC22, CCl4, and N2 (lines 70-75, 473-505). N2 is explicitly supplied as fixed dry-background VMR 0.7808. CFC profiles are optional but if supplied must be complete as a four-profile set.
comparisons.ccpp: The pinned public LW and SW wrapper interfaces accept/set only six VMR inputs (H2O, CO2, O3, N2O, CH4, O2): LW rrtmgp_lw_main.F90:82-85,119-128,291-301; SW rrtmgp_sw_main.F90:75-85,118-128,329-340. The public GFS mapper obtains its active gas-name list from configuration (GFS_rrtmgp_pre.F90:37-45) and recognizes H2O/CO2/O3/N2O/CH4/O2 plus CFC indices (lines 83-92); its gas VMR mapping shown at 349-358 supplies CO2/CH4/N2O/O2 plus separately derived water and ozone. These wrapper/mapper files do not supply N2 or CFC VMR arguments. Omission from these routines is not evidence that additional active gases are zero; that depends on active_gases_array and linked RRTMGP initialization.
comparisons.main_delta: Main's module has a single six-gas roster and no explicit N2/CFC treatment (module_ra_rrtmgp.F:34,71-89).

comparisons.candidate: The actual WRF host initialization passes gravity=g, cp_dry=cp, mol_weight_dry=mwdry*1.e-3 at module_physics_init.F:2440-2442 and 2559-2561. In the candidate's WRF/share/module_model_constants.F, g=9.81, cp=7*287/2=1004.5, and mwdry=28.966 g/mol (lines 17-20,34); thus the host passes 9.81 m s-2, 1004.5 J kg-1 K-1, and 0.028966 kg mol-1, overriding the adapter's linked-engine fallback defaults. gas_dry_column starts with get_col_dry pressure/VMR reconstruction then overwrites the native prefix using native dry mass [kg m-2] * Avogadro/(initialized molar mass [kg mol-1] * 10000) (module_ra_rrtmgp.F:583-594); LW and SW gas_optics receive col_dry explicitly. In contrast, the public CCPP wrappers pass pressure, temperature, and gas concentrations to gas_optics without col_dry or native dry mass (LW public pinned CCPP LW rrtmgp_lw_main.F90:324-332; SW rrtmgp_sw_main.F90:348-355). These wrapper lines do not establish what constants the linked RTE-RRTMGP build initializes internally, so no numeric constant comparison is claimed for that build.
comparisons.ccpp: Public CCPP wrapper calls pass layer/interface pressure and temperature plus gas_concs to gas_optics but no col_dry/native dry-mass argument (LW rrtmgp_lw_main.F90:324-332; SW rrtmgp_sw_main.F90:348-355). These wrapper files do not establish linked-engine constants or how dry columns are internally reconstructed; no numeric constant comparison with that engine is asserted.
comparisons.main_delta: The main WRF adapter calls gas_optics without explicit col_dry and has no WRF-native dry-mass override (main module lines 228-232).

comparisons.candidate: Both clear and all-sky calls invoke rte_lw(atmos,.FALSE.,source,emissivity,flux) without explicit lw_Ds or n_gauss_angles (module_ra_rrtmgp.F:815 and 900). Gas optics receives tlev and the WRF source object; source/temperature construction is in the wrapper. This source file therefore does not select the CCPP angle options explicitly.
comparisons.ccpp: The public CCPP LW wrapper computes lw_Ds using compute_optimal_angles for clear sky, passing n_gauss_angles if nGauss_angles>1 and otherwise lw_Ds (rrtmgp_lw_main.F90:495-513). All-sky calls pass n_gauss_angles=nGauss_angles (lines 547-587). This is an explicit configurable angular path unlike the candidate calls.
comparisons.main_delta: Main uses the same rte_lw call form with no explicit angle keyword (main module line 237 and all-sky call around 279).

comparisons.candidate: Without precipitation, the adapter delta-scales accumulated clouds before the all-sky solve (module_ra_rrtmgp.F:1261-1265). With precipitation, precipitation optics are produced as already delta-scaled and the cloud optics are delta-scaled once before snow is added (lines 1237-1254); the code comments state this convention. This differs from applying delta_scale to the combined cloud+precip object.
comparisons.ccpp: The public CCPP SW wrapper has its cloudy-column delta_scale() call commented out, then increments cloud optics into the accumulated all-sky object (rrtmgp_sw_main.F90:601-607). That cited wrapper block does not establish the full precipitation treatment, so the comparison is limited to the cloud delta-scale call shown there.
comparisons.main_delta: Main WRF already delta-scales clouds, and for the precipitation branch comments that precipitation is already delta-scaled and scales cloud once (main module lines 439-462).

limitations: Public source is pinned to the HAFS production/hafs.v2.2 -> forecast -> UFSATM -> CCPP and RTE-RRTMGP gitlink chain; it is not an authenticated release tag or deployed executable.
The candidate is an unmerged production-code frontier. Its module_ra_rrtmgp.F bytes are identical at PR112 evidence-only HEAD; main is separately identified and older.

The CCPP source inspected does not establish values for active gases it does not explicitly set. Do not infer omitted N2/CFC concentrations are zero without the specific active_gases_array and linked gas-concentration initialization.
The public wrappers do not pass native col_dry and do not reveal linked RTE-RRTMGP constant initialization; no numeric engine-constant equality/difference is claimed.

No accuracy or flux-equivalence conclusion is made. Gas inputs, dry-column construction, LW angular treatment and SW delta convention are source-level differences, not proof of any measured flux residual cause.
